definition.simple: A group of different atoms sticking together that carry a single electrical charge.
definition.academic: A charged chemical species (ion) composed of two or more atoms covalently bonded or of a metal complex that can be considered to be acting as a single unit.

common_misconceptions: Polyatomic ions are neutral molecules. (False: They always have an overall charge and act like a single charged particle).
ai_context.tutor_hint: When writing formulas with polyatomic ions, if you need more than one, always put them in brackets! E.g., Ca(OH)₂.
